title: BEWARE! Purchased 3 and all 3 are different/defective!
text: BEWARE! Purchased 3 and all 3 are different/defective!. Purchased one for our kitchen and we love it. Then bought 3 blinds for the dining room in the color Squirrel and they are different colors and look different, even though they are all the same color and size! All three blinds have a different size valance length! AND slats. Side by side they look AWFUL! I was so excited! Now I feel frustrated and sad! Will never recommend. And wasted time installing only to have to return! In over a decade I have NEVER returned an item out of hundreds of orders. Until today. Will add a photo. Disappointing!
